name: paste-target-guard
title: Paste Target Guard
description: Payment-target field that compares what lands in it with what was copied on the page or entered earlier, flags look-alikes of saved recipients, and shows both side by side in groups (ends first, differing characters marked) with the original one tap away.

meta.stops: Helps catch a clipboard hijacker swapping the payee address
meta.summary: Compares a pasted IBAN, UPI ID or wallet address with what was copied or expected, so a clipboard hijacker's swapped address is caught before paying.
meta.server: Confirm the payee with your provider and require step-up confirmation for new or changed recipients on the server.
catches: Pasted address that differs from what was copied on the page
Address that differs from the expected one
Matching start and end with a different middle (the clipper trick)
limits: Only sees copies made on this page (watchCopy) or the expected value you pass
Malware that also changes what the page shows can't be detected
Doesn't verify the payee; use Payee Check or your provider
a11y: Visible label; input has aria-invalid on mismatch and is described by the check
Mismatches use role=alert; a match is announced politely
Show-all and keep buttons have aria-labels
